# Concurrency and Shared State

When multiple flows touch the same memory or storage, races become defects.

## Critical sections

Serialize read–decide–write sequences on shared mutable structures unless a documented primitive already guarantees safety.

## Locks

Prefer one clear guard over scattered optimistic updates when correctness matters more than micro-latency.

## Observability

When debugging contention, capture ordering evidence—logs or assertions—rather than guessing interleavings.
